1. Code Packages

Package descriptions

No

Package

Description

01

Config

Contains configuration classes used to initialize and configure the application, such as database connections, application settings, and framework configurations.

02

Controller

Contains controller classes responsible for handling client requests, processing input, coordinating application logic, and returning appropriate responses or views.

03

Security

Contains classes responsible for application security, including authentication, authorization, password handling, and access control.

04

Service

Contains service classes that implement the application's business logic and coordinate operations between controllers and repositories.

05

DTO

Contains Data Transfer Object classes used to transfer data between different layers of the application while controlling the data exposed between components.

06

Repository

Contains repository classes responsible for accessing and managing data in the database, including querying, inserting, updating, and deleting records.

07

Exception

Contains custom exception classes used to handle and represent application-specific errors and exceptional situations.

08

Util

Contains utility and helper classes that provide reusable functions for common tasks used throughout the application.

09

Entity

Contains entity classes that represent the main business objects and their corresponding data structures used by the application.

1. Authentication & Security

1.1 Register Account

a. Class Diagram

 

b. Class Specifications

AuthController Class

No

Method

Description

01

AuthController(authService: AuthService)

Purpose: Constructor for initializing the authentication controller with required dependencies.

Inputs: authService: AuthService – Authentication business service component.

Outputs: Newly created instance of AuthController.

Internal processing: Assigns the injected AuthService dependency to the controller's private final field via constructor-based dependency injection.

02

showRegistrationForm(redirect: String, request: HttpServletRequest, authentication: Authentication, model: Model): String

Purpose: Handles HTTP GET /register requests to display the user registration form.

Inputs:

• redirect: String – Optional return URL parameter upon post-registration redirect.

• request: HttpServletRequest – Current HTTP request to access the user session.

• authentication: Authentication – Spring Security authentication principal of the current caller.

• model: Model – Spring MVC Model used to pass attributes to the view template.

Outputs: Returns String view name ("redirect:/" if already authenticated, or "authentication/register" to render the registration form).

Internal processing:

1. Checks if the user is already logged in (authenticated and not an AnonymousAuthenticationToken); if true, returns "redirect:/".

2. Validates the target redirect URL using CustomAuthenticationSuccessHandler.isValidRedirectUrl(); stores it in session or model if valid.

3. Instantiates a blank RegisterRequestDTO and binds it to the model under the attribute name "userDto" for form data binding.

4. Returns the view template name "authentication/register".

03

processRegistration(userDto: RegisterRequestDTO, bindingResult: BindingResult, model: Model, redirectAttributes: RedirectAttributes): String

Purpose: Handles HTTP POST /register requests to validate and process user account registration.

Inputs:

• userDto: RegisterRequestDTO – Form data transfer object containing fullName, email, password, and confirmPassword (validated with @Valid).

• bindingResult: BindingResult – Spring validation result holder containing JSR-380 field validation errors.

• model: Model – UI Model used to return business error messages to the view.

• redirectAttributes: RedirectAttributes – Flash attribute container for cross-redirect feedback.

Outputs: Returns String view name ("authentication/register" on failure, or "redirect:/verify-otp?email=" + email on success).

Internal processing:

1. Checks bindingResult.hasErrors(); if validation errors exist (e.g. blank fields, invalid email format, short password), returns "authentication/register" immediately to render field error messages.

2. Invokes authService.registerUser(userDto) within a try-catch block.

3. If an IllegalArgumentException is caught (e.g. email already registered, or confirm password does not match), adds errorMessage to the model and returns "authentication/register".

4. If an unexpected exception occurs, logs error details, attaches a generic system error message, and returns "authentication/register".

5. Upon successful user creation and OTP dispatch, attaches a flash success message ("Đăng ký thành công! Vui lòng kiểm tra email để nhận mã OTP.") and redirects the user to "redirect:/verify-otp?email=" + userDto.getEmail().

AuthService Interface

No

Method

Description

01

registerUser(requestDTO: RegisterRequestDTO): void

Purpose: Business service interface contract defining the operation to register a new user account.

Inputs: requestDTO: RegisterRequestDTO – Encapsulates registration credentials (fullName, email, password, confirmPassword).

Outputs: void. Throws IllegalArgumentException if business validation rules fail.

Internal processing: Contract specification for verifying unique email constraints, verifying password matching, hashing raw passwords with BCrypt, persisting a new user with default role ROLE_MEMBER and PENDING_VERIFICATION status, generating a 6-digit OTP verification token, and triggering the notification email.

AuthServiceImpl Class

No

Method

Description

01

AuthServiceImpl(userRepository: UserRepository, roleRepository: RoleRepository, tokenRepository: EmailVerificationTokenRepository, passwordEncoder: PasswordEncoder, emailService: EmailService)

Purpose: Constructor injecting all necessary data access and utility dependencies for authentication management.

Inputs:

• userRepository: UserRepository – User data access repository.

• roleRepository: RoleRepository – Role data access repository.

• tokenRepository: EmailVerificationTokenRepository – Verification token repository.

• passwordEncoder: PasswordEncoder – Spring Security BCrypt password hashing implementation.

• emailService: EmailService – Email communication service.

Outputs: Newly created instance of AuthServiceImpl.

Internal processing: Assigns all supplied dependency beans to the class's private final fields for dependency injection.

02

registerUser(requestDTO: RegisterRequestDTO): void

Purpose: Executes business transactions for registering a new user account with OTP email verification.

Inputs: requestDTO: RegisterRequestDTO – DTO carrying full name, email, password, and confirmation password.

Outputs: void. Throws IllegalArgumentException if the email is already in use or passwords mismatch.

Internal processing:

1. Executes userRepository.existsByEmail(requestDTO.getEmail()); if true, throws IllegalArgumentException("Email đã được sử dụng").

2. Checks whether requestDTO.getPassword().equals(requestDTO.getConfirmPassword()); if false, throws IllegalArgumentException("Mật khẩu xác nhận không khớp").

3. Hashes the plaintext password using passwordEncoder.encode(requestDTO.getPassword()).

4. Builds a new User entity populated with email, encoded password, full name, status "PENDING_VERIFICATION", auth provider "LOCAL", and wallet balance 0.

5. Retrieves ROLE_MEMBER from roleRepository.findByName("ROLE_MEMBER") (creates and persists it if missing), and associates it with the user's role set.

6. Persists the new user in the database via userRepository.save(user).

7. Generates a secure random 6-digit numeric OTP code (String.format("%06d", random.nextInt(1000000))).

8. Constructs an EmailVerificationToken entity referencing the persisted user, with an expiry timestamp set to 15 minutes in the future (now + 15 minutes), and saves it via tokenRepository.save(token).

9. Dispatches the verification email containing the OTP code via emailService.sendOtpEmail(user.getEmail(), otp).

sendOtpEmail(toEmail: String, otpCode: String): void

Purpose: Interface contract for sending a registration verification OTP code to a user's email address.

• otpCode: String – 6-digit numeric OTP verification code.

EmailServiceImpl Class

No

Method

Description

01

EmailServiceImpl(mailSender: JavaMailSender)

Purpose: Constructor initializing the email service implementation with Spring's mail sender.

Inputs: mailSender: JavaMailSender – Spring mail sender bean configured with SMTP settings.

Outputs: Newly created instance of EmailServiceImpl.

Internal processing: Injects and binds the JavaMailSender instance to the private final field mailSender.

02

sendOtpEmail(toEmail: String, otpCode: String): void

Purpose: Creates and dispatches an OTP email message for account registration verification.

Inputs:

• toEmail: String – Recipient's destination email address.

• otpCode: String – 6-digit numeric OTP code.

Outputs: void.

Internal processing:

1. Instantiates a SimpleMailMessage object.

2. Sets recipient address to toEmail.

3. Sets email subject line to "Mã xác nhận đăng ký tài khoản Trạm Truyện".

4. Builds the message body specifying the OTP code, 15-minute expiration window, and security advice.

5. Invokes mailSender.send(message) to transmit the email via SMTP.

UserRepository Interface

No

Method

Description

01

existsByEmail(email: String): boolean

Purpose: Checks whether an active or pending account with the specified email address already exists.

Inputs: email: String – Email address to query.

Outputs: boolean – true if a user with the given email exists in the database; false otherwise.

Internal processing: Spring Data JPA executes an optimized count query (SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM users WHERE email = ?) against PostgreSQL.

02

save(user: User): User

Purpose: Persists a new user record or updates an existing one in the database.

Inputs: user: User – User entity containing profile and credential fields.

Outputs: User – Persisted entity with assigned database primary key (id) and audit timestamps.

Internal processing: Executes SQL INSERT INTO users (...) via Hibernate's EntityManager within the current transaction context.

RoleRepository Interface

No

Method

Description

01

findByName(name: String): Optional<Role>

Purpose: Retrieves a system security role record by its unique identifier name.

Inputs: name: String – Standardized role name (e.g., "ROLE_MEMBER").

Outputs: Optional<Role> – An Optional containing the matched Role entity if found, or empty otherwise.

Internal processing: Executes a query against the roles table (SELECT * FROM roles WHERE name = ?) using Spring Data JPA.

save(role: Role): Role

Purpose: Persists a new role record into the database.

Inputs: role: Role – Role entity to persist.

Outputs: Role – Persisted Role entity with generated primary key.

EmailVerificationTokenRepository Interface

No

Method

Description

01

save(token: EmailVerificationToken): EmailVerificationToken

Purpose: Persists an email verification token record containing an OTP code and expiration timestamp.

Inputs: token: EmailVerificationToken – Token entity referencing a specific user.

Outputs: EmailVerificationToken – Persisted token entity with populated primary key.

Internal processing: Executes SQL INSERT INTO email_verification_tokens (...) via Hibernate.

02

findByOtpCodeAndUser(otpCode: String, user: User): Optional<EmailVerificationToken>

Purpose: Finds an OTP verification token belonging to a specific user for activation validation.

Inputs:

• otpCode: String – OTP code submitted by user.

• user: User – Associated user entity.

Outputs: Optional<EmailVerificationToken> – Wrapped token entity if matched, or empty Optional.

Internal processing: Executes a parameterized SQL query: SELECT * FROM email_verification_tokens WHERE otp_code = ? AND user_id = ?.

03

deleteByUser(user: User): void

Purpose: Deletes all verification tokens associated with a given user entity.

Inputs: user: User – User entity whose tokens should be purged.

Outputs: void.

Internal processing: Executes a delete query (DELETE FROM email_verification_tokens WHERE user_id = ?) to clean up expired or consumed OTP tokens.

AuthController Class

No

Method

Description

01

AuthController(authService: AuthService)

Purpose: Constructor initializing the authentication controller with required service dependencies.

Inputs: authService: AuthService – Business service handling authentication logic.

Outputs: Newly created instance of AuthController.

Internal processing: Injects and binds the AuthService instance to the private final field via Spring constructor dependency injection.

02

showLoginForm(redirect: String, request: HttpServletRequest, authentication: Authentication, model: Model): String

Purpose: Handles HTTP GET /login requests to display the login page containing local form login and the Google OAuth2 login button.

Inputs:

• redirect: String – Optional query parameter designating the return destination URL after login.

• request: HttpServletRequest – Current HTTP servlet request to access the user session.

• authentication: Authentication – Current Spring Security authentication principal.

• model: Model – UI Model to pass view attributes.

Outputs: Returns String view name ("redirect:/" if already authenticated, or "authentication/login" to render the login view).

Internal processing:

1. Checks if the user is already authenticated (and not an AnonymousAuthenticationToken); if true, returns "redirect:/".

2. Retrieves any stored return URL from the query parameter or session attribute "REDIRECT_URL".

3. Validates the return URL via CustomAuthenticationSuccessHandler.isValidRedirectUrl(); saves it to session and model if valid.

4. Returns the view template path "authentication/login".

SecurityConfig Class

No

Method

Description

01

filterChain(http: HttpSecurity): SecurityFilterChain

Purpose: Configures Spring Security HTTP filter chain and authentication mechanisms including Google OAuth2.

Inputs: http: HttpSecurity – Spring Security HTTP configuration builder.

Outputs: SecurityFilterChain – Configured security filter chain bean.

Internal processing:

1. Configures CSRF protection (ignoring /api/** endpoints).

2. Sets up URL authorization permissions (public access for /login, /register, static assets; ROLE_ADMIN for /admin/**; ROLE_STAFF for /staff/**; authenticated for /user/**, /wallet/**).

3. Configures formLogin and oauth2Login with loginPage("/login").

4. Registers CustomOAuth2UserService for Google UserInfo processing.

5. Binds CustomAuthenticationSuccessHandler and CustomAuthenticationFailureHandler for post-authentication routing and error handling.

6. Adds UserStatusCheckFilter before AuthorizationFilter to enforce real-time ban checking.

CustomOAuth2UserService Class

No

Method

Description

01

CustomOAuth2UserService(userRepository: UserRepository, roleRepository: RoleRepository, accountLockService: AccountLockService)

Purpose: Constructor injecting persistence repositories and lock management services for OAuth2 processing.

Inputs:

• userRepository: UserRepository – User data access repository.

• roleRepository: RoleRepository – Role data access repository.

• accountLockService: AccountLockService – Service for evaluating user ban/lock statuses.

Outputs: Newly created instance of CustomOAuth2UserService.

Internal processing: Injects and binds all dependencies to private final fields via constructor injection.

02

loadUser(userRequest: OAuth2UserRequest): OAuth2User

Purpose: Processes Google OAuth2 authentication by fetching user profile data and provisioning/updating local user accounts.

Inputs: userRequest: OAuth2UserRequest – Carries OAuth2 client registration information and Google access token.

Outputs: OAuth2User (CustomUserDetails instance). Throws OAuth2AuthenticationException if the user account is locked/banned.

Internal processing:

1. Calls super.loadUser(userRequest) to obtain user attributes (email, name, picture) from Google.

2. Queries userRepository.findByEmail(email).

3. If existing user: checks if status is "BANNED"; invokes accountLockService.checkAndAutoUnban(user). If still banned, throws OAuth2AuthenticationException with code "account_locked". Otherwise updates avatar if empty, updates authProvider to "GOOGLE", sets status to "ACTIVE" if pending, and persists via userRepository.save(user).

4. If new user: builds User entity with email, name, avatarUrl, authProvider "GOOGLE", status "ACTIVE", walletBalance 0. Finds/creates ROLE_MEMBER and assigns it to user. Persists via userRepository.save(user).

5. Returns new CustomUserDetails(user, attributes).

CustomAuthenticationSuccessHandler Class

No

Method

Description

01

CustomAuthenticationSuccessHandler()

Purpose: Constructor initializing default redirection targets.

Inputs: None.

Outputs: Newly created instance.

Internal processing: Sets the default fallback redirection target URL to "/".

02

onAuthenticationSuccess(request: HttpServletRequest, response: HttpServletResponse, authentication: Authentication): void

Purpose: Handles post-login routing upon successful Google OAuth2 authentication.

Inputs:

• request: HttpServletRequest – Current HTTP request.

• response: HttpServletResponse – HTTP response used to perform redirection.

• authentication: Authentication – Authentication token holding granted roles.

Outputs: void.

Internal processing:

1. Checks priority order for redirect destination: explicit "redirect" parameter, session attribute "REDIRECT_URL", or Spring Security SavedRequest.

2. If authenticated user has ROLE_ADMIN, redirects to /admin/novels (or valid /admin target).

3. If user has ROLE_STAFF, redirects to /staff/novels (or valid /staff target).

4. For standard members, redirects to the requested valid return URL or "/".

5. Clears authentication session attributes before triggering redirection.

03

isValidRedirectUrl(url: String): boolean

Purpose: Validates target redirection URLs to prevent Open Redirect security vulnerabilities.

Inputs: url: String – URL string to validate.

Outputs: boolean – true if relative, secure, and matching allowed paths; false otherwise.

Internal processing: Checks that URL starts with "/", does not contain scheme identifiers (http:, https:), "//", or backslashes, and matches whitelisted application route prefixes.

04

extractRelativePath(fullUrl: String): String

Purpose: Extracts relative path component from full absolute URLs stored in SavedRequest.

Inputs: fullUrl: String – Absolute URL string.

Outputs: String – Relative URI path including query string.

Internal processing: Parses URI and extracts the path and query portions.

Purpose: Constructor initializing the failure handler with the account lock service.

02

onAuthenticationFailure(request: HttpServletRequest, response: HttpServletResponse, exception: AuthenticationException): void

Purpose: Intercepts authentication failures and redirects banned/locked Google users to the ban details notice page.

Inputs:

• request: HttpServletRequest – Current request.

• response: HttpServletResponse – Response used for redirect.

• exception: AuthenticationException – Authentication exception thrown during login.

Outputs: void.

Internal processing:

1. Checks if exception is OAuth2AuthenticationException with error code "account_locked".

2. Extracts email from error description.

3. Invokes accountLockService.buildAccountLockedInfo(email) to retrieve detailed ban reasons and durations.

4. Stores the AccountLockedInfoDTO into session attribute "LOCKED_USER_INFO".

5. Redirects user to "/account-locked". For other exceptions, redirects to "/login?error".

AccountLockService Class

No

Method

Description

01

checkAndAutoUnban(user: User): boolean

Purpose: Verifies whether a temporary ban has expired; automatically restores user status to ACTIVE if expiration time has passed.

Inputs: user: User – Target user entity with status "BANNED".

Outputs: boolean – true if the user was unbanned; false if the ban remains active or permanent.

Internal processing:

1. Queries systemAuditLogRepository for latest "BAN_USER" audit record targeting this user.

2. Parses ban expiration timestamp (banExpiresAt) from JSON audit log.

3. If ban is temporary and current time is after expiresAt, updates status to "ACTIVE" and saves via userRepository.

4. Logs an "AUTO_UNBAN" audit record to system_audit_logs and returns true.

02

buildAccountLockedInfo(email: String): AccountLockedInfoDTO

Purpose: Builds and populates ban details DTO to present informative notice to locked users.

Inputs: email: String – Email address of the locked user.

Outputs: AccountLockedInfoDTO – Populated DTO containing ban reasons, dates, reviewer, and support email.

Internal processing: Queries userRepository for user entity; fetches latest BAN_USER audit log; extracts ban reason, duration, reviewer name, and ticket reference number; formats dates into localized display strings and constructs AccountLockedInfoDTO.

02

showLoginForm(redirect: String, request: HttpServletRequest, authentication: Authentication, model: Model): String

Purpose: Handles HTTP GET /login requests to display the user login page.

Inputs:

• redirect: String – Optional query parameter designating the return destination URL after login.

• request: HttpServletRequest – Current HTTP servlet request to access the user session.

• authentication: Authentication – Current Spring Security authentication principal.

• model: Model – UI Model to pass view attributes.

Outputs: Returns String view name ("redirect:/" if already authenticated, or "authentication/login" to render the login view).

Internal processing:

1. Checks if the user is already authenticated (and not an AnonymousAuthenticationToken); if true, returns "redirect:/".

2. Retrieves any stored return URL from the query parameter or session attribute "REDIRECT_URL".

3. Validates the return URL via CustomAuthenticationSuccessHandler.isValidRedirectUrl(); saves it to session and model if valid.

4. Returns the view template path "authentication/login".

02

filterChain(http: HttpSecurity): SecurityFilterChain

Purpose: Configures Spring Security HTTP filter chain and authentication mechanisms including form login.

Inputs: http: HttpSecurity – Spring Security HTTP configuration builder.

Outputs: SecurityFilterChain – Configured security filter chain bean.

Internal processing:

1. Configures CSRF protection (ignoring /api/** endpoints).

2. Sets up URL authorization permissions (public access for /login, /register, static assets; ROLE_ADMIN for /admin/**; ROLE_STAFF for /staff/**; authenticated for /user/**, /wallet/**).

3. Configures formLogin with loginPage("/login"), loginProcessingUrl("/login").

4. Binds CustomAuthenticationSuccessHandler and CustomAuthenticationFailureHandler for post-authentication routing and error handling.

5. Configures rememberMe authentication (30-day validity, key, userDetailsService).

6. Configures logout and registers UserStatusCheckFilter before AuthorizationFilter to enforce real-time ban checking.

02

onAuthenticationSuccess(request: HttpServletRequest, response: HttpServletResponse, authentication: Authentication): void

Purpose: Handles post-login routing upon successful username/password authentication.

Inputs:

• request: HttpServletRequest – Current HTTP request.

• response: HttpServletResponse – HTTP response used to perform redirection.

• authentication: Authentication – Authentication token holding granted roles.

Outputs: void.

Internal processing:

1. Checks priority order for redirect destination: explicit "redirect" parameter, session attribute "REDIRECT_URL", or Spring Security SavedRequest.

2. If authenticated user has ROLE_ADMIN, redirects to /admin/novels (or valid /admin target).

3. If user has ROLE_STAFF, redirects to /staff/novels (or valid /staff target).

4. For standard members, redirects to the requested valid return URL or "/".

5. Clears authentication session attributes before triggering redirection.

03

isValidRedirectUrl(url: String): boolean

Purpose: Validates target redirection URLs to prevent Open Redirect security vulnerabilities.

Inputs: url: String – URL string to validate.

Outputs: boolean – true if relative, secure, and matching allowed paths; false otherwise.

Internal processing: Checks that URL starts with "/", does not contain scheme identifiers (http:, https:), "//", or backslashes, and matches whitelisted application route prefixes.

04

extractRelativePath(fullUrl: String): String

Purpose: Extracts relative path component from full absolute URLs stored in SavedRequest.

Inputs: fullUrl: String – Absolute URL string.

Outputs: String – Relative URI path including query string.

Internal processing: Parses URI and extracts the path and query portions.

02

onAuthenticationFailure(request: HttpServletRequest, response: HttpServletResponse, exception: AuthenticationException): void

Purpose: Intercepts form login failures and redirects banned/locked users to the ban details notice page, or returns login error query parameters.

Inputs:

• request: HttpServletRequest – Current request.

• response: HttpServletResponse – Response used for redirect.

• exception: AuthenticationException – Exception thrown during authentication.

Outputs: void.

Internal processing:

1. If exception is LockedException: retrieves email from request parameter "username"; calls accountLockService.buildAccountLockedInfo(email) to fetch ban reasons/dates; stores AccountLockedInfoDTO into session attribute "LOCKED_USER_INFO"; redirects to "/account-locked".

2. If exception is DisabledException: redirects to "/login?error=disabled" (prompting unverified users to verify email).

3. For other credential exceptions (e.g. BadCredentialsException): redirects to "/login?error".

AccountLockService Class

No

Method

Description

01

checkAndAutoUnban(user: User): boolean

Purpose: Verifies whether a temporary ban has expired; automatically restores user status to ACTIVE if expiration time has passed.

Inputs: user: User – Target user entity with status "BANNED".

Outputs: boolean – true if the user was unbanned; false if the ban remains active or permanent.

Internal processing:

1. Queries systemAuditLogRepository for latest "BAN_USER" audit record targeting this user.

2. Parses ban expiration timestamp (banExpiresAt) from JSON audit log.

3. If ban is temporary and current time is after expiresAt, updates status to "ACTIVE" and saves via userRepository.

4. Logs an "AUTO_UNBAN" audit record to system_audit_logs and returns true.

02

buildAccountLockedInfo(email: String): AccountLockedInfoDTO

Purpose: Builds and populates ban details DTO to present informative notice to locked users.

Inputs: email: String – Email address of the locked user.

Outputs: AccountLockedInfoDTO – Populated DTO containing ban reasons, dates, reviewer, and support email.

Internal processing: Queries userRepository for user entity; fetches latest BAN_USER audit log; extracts ban reason, duration, reviewer name, and ticket reference number; formats dates into localized display strings and constructs AccountLockedInfoDTO.

1.4 Logout

a. Class Diagram

 

b. Class Specifications

SecurityConfig Class

No

Method

Description

01

filterChain(http: HttpSecurity): SecurityFilterChain

Purpose: Configures Spring Security filter chain and defines user logout specifications.

Inputs: http: HttpSecurity – Spring Security HTTP builder.

Outputs: SecurityFilterChain – Configured security filter chain bean.

Internal processing:

1. Configures logout handling via logoutUrl("/logout") and sets logoutSuccessUrl("/").

2. Configures session invalidation and deletion of authentication cookies ("JSESSIONID", "remember-me").

3. Binds UserStatusCheckFilter before AuthorizationFilter to enforce status verification on protected requests.

4. Configures route authorization allowing unauthenticated access to the homepage following logout.

UserStatusCheckFilter Class

No

Method

Description

01

UserStatusCheckFilter(userRepository: UserRepository, accountLockService: AccountLockService)

Purpose: Constructor initializing user status verification filter with data access and lock management services.

Inputs:

• userRepository: UserRepository – User persistence repository.

• accountLockService: AccountLockService – Account lock evaluation service.

Outputs: Newly created instance of UserStatusCheckFilter.

Internal processing: Injects and binds dependencies to private final fields.

02

shouldNotFilter(request: HttpServletRequest): boolean

Purpose: Determines whether current HTTP request should bypass filter execution.

Inputs: request: HttpServletRequest – Incoming servlet request.

Outputs: boolean – true if request URI matches static assets (/css/**, /js/**, /images/**) or public endpoints (/login, /logout, /register, /account-locked); false otherwise.

Internal processing: Compares request URI against whitelisted public path prefixes and bypasses filtering for the logout endpoint ("/logout").

03

doFilterInternal(request: HttpServletRequest, response: HttpServletResponse, filterChain: FilterChain): void

Purpose: Enforces active account checks on each request; blocks banned users from continuing their session.

Inputs:

• request: HttpServletRequest – Current HTTP request.

• response: HttpServletResponse – Current HTTP response.

• filterChain: FilterChain – Filter execution chain.

Outputs: void.

Internal processing:

1. Inspects SecurityContextHolder for authenticated principal of type CustomUserDetails.

2. If unauthenticated (such as after logout) or non-user principal, calls filterChain.doFilter(request, response) and exits.

3. If authenticated, queries active user status from database via userRepository.findStatusById(userId).

4. If status is "BANNED", evaluates auto-unban; if still banned, invalidates session, clears security context, clears remember-me cookie, and redirects to "/account-locked".

5. Otherwise, passes execution along the filter chain.

02

showForgotPasswordForm(): String

Purpose: Handles HTTP GET /forgot-password requests to display the forgot password email submission form.

Inputs: None.

Outputs: Returns String view template name "authentication/forgot-password".

Internal processing: Renders and returns the forgot password input view.

03

processForgotPassword(email: String, model: Model, redirectAttributes: RedirectAttributes): String

Purpose: Handles HTTP POST /forgot-password requests to initiate password reset OTP generation and dispatch verification email.

Inputs:

• email: String – Account email address submitted by user.

• model: Model – Spring MVC model for returning error messages to the view.

• redirectAttributes: RedirectAttributes – Flash attributes holder for preserving success message across redirect.

Outputs: Returns redirect URL String "redirect:/forgot-password/verify-otp?email=" + email on success, or view template "authentication/forgot-password" on error.

Internal processing:

1. Calls authService.sendForgotPasswordOtp(email) to validate account and dispatch OTP email.

2. On success, adds flash attribute "successMessage" and redirects user to the OTP verification page.

3. Catches IllegalArgumentException (e.g., account not found, OAuth account, banned account) or general Exception, populates "errorMessage" in model, and re-renders the forgot password form.

04

showForgotPasswordVerifyOtpPage(email: String, model: Model): String

Purpose: Handles HTTP GET /forgot-password/verify-otp requests to display OTP code entry screen.

Inputs:

• email: String – Email parameter passed in request URL.

• model: Model – Spring MVC model for binding email attribute to the template.

Outputs: Returns String view template name "authentication/forgot-password-verify-otp".

Internal processing: Attaches email attribute to the model and returns the OTP verification view.

05

processForgotPasswordVerifyOtp(email: String, otpCode: String, model: Model, request: HttpServletRequest): String

Purpose: Handles HTTP POST /forgot-password/verify-otp requests to validate the submitted OTP code.

Inputs:

• email: String – Account email address.

• otpCode: String – 6-digit verification code entered by user.

• model: Model – Model for error messaging.

• request: HttpServletRequest – HTTP servlet request to access user session.

Outputs: Returns redirect URL String "redirect:/forgot-password/reset" on success, or view template "authentication/forgot-password-verify-otp" on error.

Internal processing:

1. Calls authService.verifyForgotPasswordOtp(email, otpCode) to validate OTP correctness and expiration.

2. On success, stores "RESET_PASSWORD_EMAIL" in the HTTP session as authorization token for the next step.

3. Redirects browser to "/forgot-password/reset".

4. On failure, catches exception, sets "errorMessage" and retains "email" in model, and reloads OTP verification page.

06

showResetPasswordForm(request: HttpServletRequest, model: Model): String

Purpose: Handles HTTP GET /forgot-password/reset requests to display new password creation form.

Inputs:

• request: HttpServletRequest – HTTP servlet request to verify active session.

• model: Model – Spring MVC model.

Outputs: Returns view template "authentication/reset-password", or redirect "redirect:/forgot-password" if unauthorized.

Internal processing:

1. Checks if session exists and contains attribute "RESET_PASSWORD_EMAIL".

2. If missing or invalid, redirects to "/forgot-password" to prevent unauthorized direct URL access.

3. If authorized, renders view template "authentication/reset-password".

07

processResetPassword(newPassword: String, confirmPassword: String, request: HttpServletRequest, model: Model, redirectAttributes: RedirectAttributes): String

Purpose: Handles HTTP POST /forgot-password/reset requests to validate and update the account password.

Inputs:

• newPassword: String – New password entered by user.

• confirmPassword: String – Password confirmation string.

• request: HttpServletRequest – HTTP servlet request to access session attributes.

• model: Model – Model for error messaging.

• redirectAttributes: RedirectAttributes – Flash attributes holder for success notification.

Outputs: Returns redirect URL "redirect:/login" on success, view template "authentication/reset-password" on error, or "redirect:/forgot-password" if unauthorized.

Internal processing:

1. Checks if session contains valid "RESET_PASSWORD_EMAIL"; redirects to "/forgot-password" if missing.

2. Verifies newPassword matches confirmPassword; displays error if mismatched.

3. Invokes authService.resetPassword(email, newPassword) to encode and persist password.

4. Removes "RESET_PASSWORD_EMAIL" session attribute to prevent replay attacks.

5. Adds flash attribute "successMessage" and redirects to "/login".

6. On exception, catches error, populates "errorMessage" in model, and reloads reset password form.

01

• roleRepository: RoleRepository – Role persistence repository.

• passwordEncoder: PasswordEncoder – BCrypt password hashing encoder.

• emailService: EmailService – Service for sending email notifications.

Outputs: Newly created instance of AuthServiceImpl.

Internal processing: Injects and binds all dependencies to private final fields.

02

sendForgotPasswordOtp(email: String): void

Purpose: Validates account status, generates a 6-digit OTP code with 15-minute expiration, and dispatches recovery email.

Inputs: email: String – Account email address requesting password reset.

Outputs: void.

Internal processing:

1. Queries userRepository.findByEmail(email); throws IllegalArgumentException if account does not exist.

2. Verifies user.getAuthProvider() equals "LOCAL"; throws IllegalArgumentException if user logged in via OAuth (e.g. Google).

3. Verifies user.getStatus() is not "BANNED"; throws IllegalArgumentException if account is locked.

4. Removes existing expired or unused OTP tokens via tokenRepository.deleteByUser(user).

5. Generates random 6-digit numeric OTP code using Random and String.format("%06d", ...).

6. Builds EmailVerificationToken with 15-minute expiration time (LocalDateTime.now().plusMinutes(15)) and saves via tokenRepository.save(token).

7. Calls emailService.sendForgotPasswordOtpEmail(user.getEmail(), otp) to deliver code to user.

03

verifyForgotPasswordOtp(email: String, otp: String): void

Purpose: Verifies that the submitted OTP code matches the active token and has not expired.

Inputs:

• email: String – User email address.

• otp: String – 6-digit OTP code to verify.

Outputs: void.

Internal processing:

1. Queries user by email; throws IllegalArgumentException if not found.

2. Queries tokenRepository.findByOtpCodeAndUser(otp, user); throws IllegalArgumentException if OTP code is incorrect.

3. Checks token.getExpiryDate().isBefore(LocalDateTime.now()); throws IllegalArgumentException if token has expired.

4. Exits normally upon successful verification.

04

resetPassword(email: String, newPassword: String): void

Purpose: Validates password complexity policy, encrypts new password, persists update, and removes OTP tokens.

Inputs:

• email: String – Target user account email.

• newPassword: String – New plaintext password string.

Outputs: void.

Internal processing:

1. Validates password complexity: must be at least 8 characters and contain at least one uppercase letter (matches ".*[A-Z].*"); throws IllegalArgumentException on violation.

2. Queries userRepository.findByEmail(email); throws IllegalArgumentException if user not found.

3. Hashes newPassword using passwordEncoder.encode(newPassword) and updates user.setPassword(...).

4. Persists updated user via userRepository.save(user).

5. Deletes all associated tokens for the user via tokenRepository.deleteByUser(user).

5. Sends email via mailSender.send(message).

viewProfile(authentication: Authentication, model: Model): String

Purpose: Handles HTTP GET /user/profile requests to render the personal profile overview page.

Inputs:

• authentication: Authentication – Current Spring Security principal context.

• model: Model – Spring MVC model for passing user profile attributes to view template.

Outputs: Returns String view template name "user/profile", or redirect URL "redirect:/login?redirect=/user/profile" if unauthenticated.

Internal processing:

1. Checks if authentication is null, not authenticated, or an instance of AnonymousAuthenticationToken; redirects to "/login" if so.

2. Extracts authenticated user's email via authentication.getName().

3. Invokes bookshelfService.getUserProfile(email) to retrieve user profile DTO.

4. Invokes bookshelfService.getUserBookshelf(email).size() to calculate total saved novels.

5. Binds "userProfile" and "totalSavedNovels" attributes into the model.

6. Returns view template "user/profile".

1. Resolves User entity via getUserByEmail(email).

2. Queries bookshelfRepository.findAllByUserWithNovel(user).

viewEditProfile(authentication: Authentication, model: Model): String

Purpose: Handles HTTP GET /user/edit-profile requests to render the profile editing page.

Inputs:

• authentication: Authentication – Current Spring Security principal context.

• model: Model – Spring MVC model to pass current profile attributes.

Outputs: Returns String view template name "user/edit-profile", or redirect "redirect:/login?redirect=/user/edit-profile" if unauthenticated.

03

updateProfile(authentication: Authentication, fullName: String, avatar: MultipartFile, redirectAttributes: RedirectAttributes): String

Purpose: Handles HTTP POST /user/edit-profile requests to update user display name and upload new avatar.

Inputs:

• authentication: Authentication – Current security principal context.

• fullName: String – Updated user display name string.

• avatar: MultipartFile – Optional uploaded avatar image file.

• redirectAttributes: RedirectAttributes – Flash attributes holder for feedback messages.

Outputs: Returns redirect URL "redirect:/user/profile" on success, or "redirect:/user/edit-profile" on error.

Internal processing:

2. Extracts user email via authentication.getName().

03

changePassword(authentication: Authentication, oldPassword: String, newPassword: String, redirectAttributes: RedirectAttributes): String

Purpose: Handles HTTP POST /user/change-password requests to verify current password and apply new password update.

Inputs:

• authentication: Authentication – Current security principal context.

• oldPassword: String – Current plaintext password entered by user.

• newPassword: String – New plaintext password string.

• redirectAttributes: RedirectAttributes – Flash attributes holder for feedback messages across redirect.

Outputs: Returns redirect URL "redirect:/user/profile" on success, or "redirect:/user/change-password" on error.

Internal processing:

4. Adds flash attribute "successMessage" ("Đổi mật khẩu thành công") and redirects to "/user/profile".

5. Catches IllegalArgumentException (e.g. incorrect old password), populates flash attribute "errorMessage", and redirects back to "/user/change-password".

02

showWallet(authentication: Authentication, model: Model): String

Purpose: Handles HTTP GET /wallet requests to render the personal wallet dashboard and transaction history view.

Inputs:

• authentication: Authentication – Current Spring Security principal context.

• model: Model – Spring MVC model for passing wallet overview data to the view template.

Outputs: Returns String view template name "wallet/index", or redirect "redirect:/login?redirect=/wallet" if unauthenticated.

Internal processing:

1. Validates authentication context; redirects to "/login" if unauthenticated.

2. Resolves User entity via userRepository.findByEmail(authentication.getName()).

3. Invokes walletService.getWalletOverview(user) to compute wallet balance, status, wallet code, and recent transactions.

4. Attaches "wallet", "user", "vndToCoinRate", and "vndPerCoinFormatted" attributes to model.

5. Returns view template "wallet/index".

03

getTransactionsApi(authentication: Authentication, type: String, keyword: String, date: String, page: int, size: int): ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>>

Purpose: REST API endpoint handling HTTP GET /api/wallet/transactions for dynamic filtering and pagination of transactions.

Inputs:

• authentication: Authentication – Current security principal context.

• type: String – Transaction filter type (e.g. "ALL", "DEPOSIT", "UNLOCK_CHAPTER").

• keyword: String – Search keyword (title, description, or order code).

• date: String – Date filter string in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

• page: int – Page index (0-indexed, default 0).

• size: int – Page size (default 5).

Outputs: ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> – JSON payload containing content list, currentPage, totalPages, totalElements, and isLast flag.

Internal processing:

1. Checks authentication status; returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized if unauthenticated.

2. Retrieves User entity by authenticated email from userRepository.

3. Parses date string into LocalDate if provided.

4. Invokes walletService.searchTransactions(user, type, keyword, filterDate, page, size).

5. Assembles pagination metadata map and returns HTTP 200 OK with JSON response.

01

Purpose: Constructor initializing wallet service implementation with repository dependencies.

Inputs:

• transactionRepository: TransactionRepository – Coin transaction ledger repository.

• topupOrderRepository: TopupOrderRepository – Top-up order data repository.

Outputs: Newly created instance of WalletServiceImpl.

Internal processing: Injects and binds repository dependencies to private final fields.

02

getWalletOverview(user: User): WalletOverviewDTO

Purpose: Loads fresh user balance, computes wallet status, determines latest activity timestamp, and builds WalletOverviewDTO.

Inputs: user: User – Target user entity.

Outputs: WalletOverviewDTO – Wallet summary data transfer object.

Internal processing:

1. Reloads user by ID from userRepository to ensure updated balance.

2. Formats balance with thousands separator and generates wallet code (e.g. #WALLET-000123).

3. Inspects transactionRepository and topupOrderRepository for most recent activity timestamp.

4. Computes total transactions count and loads first page of transactions (size = 5).

5. Returns populated WalletOverviewDTO instance.

03

searchTransactions(user: User, type: String, keyword: String, date: LocalDate, page: int, size: int): Page<TransactionDTO>

Purpose: Filters transactions by type, text keyword, and creation date; aggregates ledger entries and failed topup orders into a paginated list.

Inputs:

• user: User – Associated user entity.

• type: String – Transaction type (DEPOSIT, UNLOCK_CHAPTER, DAILY_CHECKIN, or null/ALL).

• keyword: String – Search query matching description or order code.

• date: LocalDate – Calendar date filter.

• page: int – 0-indexed page index.

• size: int – Maximum page size.

Outputs: Page<TransactionDTO> – Paginated collection of TransactionDTOs.

Internal processing:

1. Queries ledger records from transactionRepository.findByUserIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(user.getId()).

2. Applies filters for type, date, and keyword.

3. If type filter allows deposits, includes failed/cancelled orders from topupOrderRepository.

4. Sorts aggregated items by timestamp descending.

5. Slices sublist corresponding to requested page and size, wrapping in PageImpl.

PaymentController Class

No

Method

Description

01

PaymentController(coinPackageService: CoinPackageService, vnPayService: VNPayService, userRepository: UserRepository, systemSettingService: SystemSettingService)

Purpose: Constructor initializing payment controller with coin package service, VNPay gateway service, user repository, and system configuration service.

Inputs:

• coinPackageService: CoinPackageService – Service for retrieving active top-up packages.

• vnPayService: VNPayService – Service handling VNPay gateway integration.

• userRepository: UserRepository – User persistence repository.

• systemSettingService: SystemSettingService – System setting provider for conversion rates.

Outputs: Newly created instance of PaymentController.

Internal processing: Injects and binds all dependencies to private final class fields.

02

showTopupPage(authentication: Authentication, model: Model): String

Purpose: Handles HTTP GET /wallet/topup requests to display the coin package selection and payment method interface.

Inputs:

• authentication: Authentication – Current Spring Security principal context.

• model: Model – Spring MVC model for passing page data.

Outputs: Returns String view template name "wallet/topup", or redirect "redirect:/login?redirect=/wallet/topup" if unauthenticated.

Internal processing:

1. Validates user authentication context; redirects to login if unauthenticated.

2. Retrieves current User entity via userRepository.findByEmail(authentication.getName()).

3. Calls coinPackageService.getActivePackages() to fetch all available active coin packages.

4. Attaches user, walletBalance, packages, vndToCoinRate, and vndPerCoinFormatted attributes to model.

5. Returns view template "wallet/topup".

03

processTopup(authentication: Authentication, packageId: Integer, request: HttpServletRequest): String

Purpose: Handles HTTP POST /wallet/topup/process requests to create a pending order and redirect the user to the VNPay Sandbox payment gateway.

Inputs:

• authentication: Authentication – Current user security context.

• packageId: Integer – Selected coin package primary key.

• request: HttpServletRequest – Servlet request for determining client IP address.

Outputs: Returns redirect URL string to VNPay payment gateway ("redirect:" + vnpayUrl).

Internal processing:

1. Verifies authentication; redirects to login if unauthorized.

2. Loads user entity by authenticated email from userRepository.

3. Resolves client IP address via VNPayUtil.getIpAddress(request).

4. Calls vnPayService.createPaymentUrl(user, packageId, clientIp) to persist a PENDING order and construct the signed payment gateway URL.

5. Returns redirect to the generated VNPay gateway URL.

04

handlePaymentReturn(allParams: Map<String, String>, model: Model): String

Purpose: Handles HTTP GET /payment/vnpay-return requests when the user is redirected back to the platform following payment completion.

Inputs:

• allParams: Map<String, String> – Query parameters returned by VNPay gateway.

• model: Model – Spring MVC model for passing payment result DTO to view.

Outputs: Returns view template "wallet/payment-success" if payment succeeded, or "wallet/payment-failure" on failure/cancellation.

Internal processing:

1. Calls vnPayService.processReturn(allParams) to verify cryptographic checksum, update order status, and credit coins.

2. Binds returned PaymentResultDTO to model attribute "result".

3. Inspects result.isSuccess(): returns "wallet/payment-success" on true; "wallet/payment-failure" on false.

05

handlePaymentIpn(allParams: Map<String, String>, request: HttpServletRequest): Map<String, String>

Purpose: Webhook endpoint handling HTTP GET /api/payment/vnpay-ipn for server-to-server asynchronous transaction verification.

Inputs:

• allParams: Map<String, String> – URL request parameters dispatched by VNPay server.

• request: HttpServletRequest – Servlet request to extract remote server IP address.

Outputs: Map<String, String> – Response containing RspCode and Message complying with VNPay IPN protocol.

Internal processing:

1. Extracts remote IP address via VNPayUtil.getIpAddress(request).

2. Invokes vnPayService.processIpn(allParams, clientIp) to record payload, verify signature, and fulfill order.

3. Returns JSON map containing RspCode ("00", "01", "02", "04", "97") and Message.

VNPayServiceImpl Class

No

Method

Description

01

VNPayServiceImpl(vnPayProperties: VNPayProperties, coinPackageRepository: CoinPackageRepository, topupOrderRepository: TopupOrderRepository, paymentLogRepository: PaymentLogRepository, transactionRepository: TransactionRepository, userRepository: UserRepository)

Purpose: Constructor initializing VNPay service implementation with configuration properties and persistence repositories.

Inputs: Repositories for packages, orders, logs, transactions, users, and VNPay properties bean.

Outputs: Newly created instance of VNPayServiceImpl.

Internal processing: Injects and binds all dependencies to private final fields.

02

createPaymentUrl(user: User, packageId: Integer, ipAddress: String): String

Purpose: Generates unique order code, persists TopupOrder with PENDING status, and constructs HMAC-SHA512 signed VNPay URL.

Inputs:

• user: User – Payer user entity.

• packageId: Integer – Package ID.

• ipAddress: String – User IP address.

Outputs: String – Complete VNPay payment gateway redirect URL.

Internal processing:

1. Loads CoinPackage by ID; generates order code (TT + timestamp + random suffix).

2. Saves TopupOrder entity with status PENDING.

3. Builds VNPay query map (vnp_Amount * 100, vnp_TxnRef, vnp_CreateDate, vnp_ExpireDate).

4. Computes secure HMAC-SHA512 hash and returns full redirect URL.

03

processReturn(params: Map<String, String>): PaymentResultDTO

Purpose: Validates cryptographic checksum of return parameters, updates order status, fulfills coins if successful, and builds result DTO.

Inputs: params: Map<String, String> – Query parameters received from VNPay return.

Outputs: PaymentResultDTO – Result summary data transfer object.

Internal processing:

1. Strips vnp_SecureHash and recalculates HMAC-SHA512 checksum.

2. Checks if checksum matches and responseCode == "00".

3. If valid and order is PENDING, calls fulfillOrder(order, transactionNo).

4. If invalid, marks order as FAILED.

5. Assembles and returns PaymentResultDTO.

04

processIpn(params: Map<String, String>, ipAddress: String): Map<String, String>

Purpose: Secure asynchronous IPN handler that logs raw payload, verifies signature, validates order amount, and confirms order.

Inputs:

• params: Map<String, String> – Parameter map from VNPay server.

• ipAddress: String – Calling server IP.

Outputs: Map<String, String> – VNPay response map (RspCode and Message).

Internal processing:

1. Persists raw payload into payment_logs table.

2. Validates HMAC-SHA512 checksum; returns RspCode "97" if invalid.

3. Checks order existence; returns RspCode "01" if not found.

4. Validates order amount; returns RspCode "04" if mismatched.

5. Verifies order is PENDING; returns RspCode "02" if already confirmed.

6. On responseCode "00", invokes fulfillOrder(order, transactionNo) and returns RspCode "00".

05

fulfillOrder(order: TopupOrder, transactionNo: String): void

Purpose: Synchronized internal method updating order to SUCCESS, crediting user wallet balance, and recording transaction ledger entry.

Inputs:

• order: TopupOrder – Order entity being fulfilled.

• transactionNo: String – VNPay transaction reference code.

Outputs: void.

Internal processing:

1. Verifies order is still PENDING to prevent duplicate fulfillment.

2. Updates order status to SUCCESS, sets bankTransactionCode and paidAt.

3. Credits order.getCoinReceived() to user wallet balance and saves user.

4. Synchronizes session balance in SecurityContext if user is logged in.

5. Persists credit ledger entry in transactions table with type "DEPOSIT".

06

getFriendlyErrorMessage(responseCode: String): String

Purpose: Translates VNPay numerical response codes into user-friendly localized explanation messages.

Inputs: responseCode: String – VNPay response code string (e.g. "24", "51", "11").

Outputs: String – Localized error description.

Internal processing: Maps response code through switch expression to descriptive Vietnamese message.

c. Sequence Diagram(s)

d. Database Queries

SELECT id, email, password, full_name, avatar_url, wallet_balance, auth_provider, status, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE email = ?;

SELECT id, name, price, coin_amount, status, created_at FROM coin_packages WHERE id = ?;

INSERT INTO topup_orders (user_id, package_id, order_code, amount_vnd, coin_received, status, payment_method, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'PENDING', 'VNPAY', ?, ?);

SELECT id, user_id, package_id, order_code, amount_vnd, coin_received, status, payment_method, bank_transaction_code, paid_at, created_at, updated_at FROM topup_orders WHERE order_code = ?;

UPDATE topup_orders SET status = ?, bank_transaction_code = ?, paid_at = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?;

UPDATE users SET wallet_balance = wallet_balance + ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?;

INSERT INTO transactions (user_id, amount, balance_after, type, reference_id, description, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'TOPUP', ?, ?, ?);

Method

02

getAuditStats(): TransactionAuditStatsDTO

Purpose: Calculates real-time financial stats.
Inputs: None.

Internal processing: Queries SUM(final_amount) and SUM(coins) from topup_orders where status='SUCCESS', SUM(ABS(amount)) from transactions where amount < 0, and calculates consumption percentage.

03

getAuditTransactions(startDate: LocalDate, endDate: LocalDate, type: String, orderCode: String, email: String, page: int, size: int): Page<TransactionAuditDTO>

Purpose: Executes CTE SQL combining topup_orders (source_type='TOPUP') and transactions (source_type='LEDGER') with dynamic filters.
Inputs: Filter parameters and pagination indices.
Outputs: Page<TransactionAuditDTO>.
Internal processing: Builds dynamic WHERE clause, executes count query and paginated record query, maps ResultSet to TransactionAuditDTO.

c. Sequence Diagram(s)

d. Database Queries 

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(final_amount), 0) AS total_vnd, COALESCE(SUM(coins), 0) AS total_coins FROM topup_orders WHERE status = 'SUCCESS';

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ABS(amount)), 0) AS consumed_coins FROM transactions WHERE amount < 0;

WITH unified_tx AS (SELECT id, user_id, order_code, final_amount, coins, 'TOPUP' AS source_type, created_at FROM topup_orders WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' UNION ALL SELECT id, user_id, NULL, 0, amount, 'LEDGER', created_at FROM transactions WHERE type != 'DEPOSIT') SELECT * FROM unified_tx WHERE (:type IS NULL OR source_type = :type) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset;

ChapterUnlockServiceImpl Class

Method

Description

01

isChapterUnlocked

- Input: email: String, chapterId: Integer.

- Output: boolean.

- Internal Method Processing: Checks if the chapter is free, if the user has a privileged role (ROLE_ADMIN/ROLE_STAFF), or if an unlocked UserChapterActivity record exists.

02

unlockChapter

- Input: email: String, chapterId: Integer, autoUnlockNext: Boolean.

- Output: UnlockResultDTO.

- Internal Method Processing: Fetches the Chapter by ID and validates eligibility via validateChapterEligibility(chapter). Acquires a pessimistic write lock on the User via userRepository.findByEmailWithLock(email). If the user is privileged, already unlocked the chapter, or the chapter is free, returns a 0-Coin UnlockResultDTO. Otherwise, deducts the chapter price via walletService.deductCoins(lockedUser, price, "UNLOCK_CHAPTER", chapterId, description), records the unlock via markChapterUnlocked(), and returns the completed UnlockResultDTO.

03

validateChapterEligibility

- Input: chapter: Chapter.

- Output: void.

- Internal Method Processing: Ensures neither the chapter nor its novel is soft-deleted, the novel is not ARCHIVED, and the chapter status is not DRAFT or LOCKED; otherwise throws ChapterNotPurchasableException.

04

buildTransactionDescription

- Input: chapter: Chapter.

- Output: String.

- Internal Method Processing: Formats a human-readable ledger description containing the chapter number, chapter title, and novel title.

05

markChapterUnlocked

- Input: user: User, chapter: Chapter, price: int, existingOpt: Optional<UserChapterActivity>.

- Output: void.

- Internal Method Processing: Creates or updates the UserChapterActivity entity with isUnlocked = true, pricePaid = price, and unlockedAt = LocalDateTime.now(), then saves it via userChapterActivityRepository.save(activity).

WalletServiceImpl Class

No

Method

Description

01

deductCoins

- Input: user: User, amount: int, transactionType: String, referenceId: Integer, description: String.

- Output: void.

- Internal Method Processing: Locks the user row using userRepository.findByIdWithLock(userId). Checks if walletBalance >= amount; if insufficient, throws InsufficientBalanceException. Subtracts amount from walletBalance, saves the updated User via userRepository.save(lockedUser), creates a Transaction record with amount = -price and type = "UNLOCK_CHAPTER", and persists it via transactionRepository.save(tx).

c. Sequence Diagram(s)

d. Database Queries

1. Retrieve public novel by slug

SELECT id, title, slug, status, is_deleted FROM novels WHERE slug = ? AND is_deleted = FALSE AND status <> 'ARCHIVED';

2. Retrieve published chapter by novel ID and chapter number

SELECT id, novel_id, chapter_number, title, price, status, is_deleted FROM chapters WHERE novel_id = ? AND chapter_number = ? AND is_deleted = FALSE AND status IN ('PUBLISHED_REGULAR', 'PUBLISHED_VIP', 'PUBLISHED');

3. Retrieve chapter by ID for eligibility check

SELECT id, novel_id, chapter_number, title, price, status, is_deleted FROM chapters WHERE id = ?;

4. Retrieve authenticated user by email

SELECT id, email, full_name, wallet_balance, status FROM users WHERE email = ?;

5. Check existing user chapter activity

SELECT id, user_id, chapter_id, is_read, read_at, is_unlocked, price_paid, unlocked_at FROM user_chapter_activities WHERE user_id = ? AND chapter_id = ?;

6. Deduct Coin price from user wallet balance

UPDATE users SET wallet_balance = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?;

7. Insert UNLOCK_CHAPTER transaction into wallet ledger

INSERT INTO transactions (user_id, amount, balance_after, type, reference_id, description, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'UNLOCK_CHAPTER', ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) RETURNING id;

8. Record permanent VIP chapter unlock for new activity

INSERT INTO user_chapter_activities (user_id, chapter_id, is_unlocked, price_paid, unlocked_at) VALUES (?, ?, TRUE, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) RETURNING id;

9. Update existing chapter activity to unlocked status

UPDATE user_chapter_activities SET is_unlocked = TRUE, price_paid = ?, unlocked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?;

No

Method

Description

01

createChapter(novelId : Integer, form : ChapterForm, action : ChapterSaveAction) : Chapter

Purpose: Create a new chapter of a novel in the draft or published state.

Inputs: novelId: Integer — the identifier of the parent novel; form: ChapterForm — the validated form data; action: ChapterSaveAction — DRAFT or PUBLISHED.

Outputs: The persisted Chapter entity; ResourceNotFoundException ("Không tìm thấy truyện") when the novel does not exist, DuplicateResourceException ("Số chương đã tồn tại trong truyện này") when the chapter number is already used and IllegalArgumentException ("Giá Coin phải lớn hơn hoặc bằng 0") when the price is negative.

Internal processing: Call findActiveNovel(novelId) to load the parent novel; call chapterRepository.existsByNovelIdAndChapterNumber(novelId, form.getChapterNumber()) and throw the DuplicateResourceException when it returns true; call resolvePrice(form) to validate the price; build the entity with the trimmed title, the sanitized content, the resolved status and price, and the reference to the novel; call chapterRepository.save(chapter) to persist it; when the action is PUBLISHED, call notificationService.notifyNewChapterPublished(novelId, savedChapter.getId()) to inform the followers. The whole operation runs in one write transaction.

02

findActiveNovel(novelId : Integer) : Novel

Purpose: Find the parent novel by its identifier, ignoring the soft-deleted records.

Inputs: novelId: Integer — the identifier of the novel.

Outputs: The Novel entity; ResourceNotFoundException ("Không tìm thấy truyện") when the novel does not exist or has been deleted.

Internal processing: Call novelRepository.findByIdAndIsDeletedFalse(novelId) and throw the exception when the result is empty.

03

resolvePrice(form : ChapterForm) : int

Purpose: Determine and validate the coin price of the new chapter.

Inputs: form: ChapterForm — the submitted form data.

Outputs: int — the valid price; IllegalArgumentException ("Giá Coin phải lớn hơn hoặc bằng 0") when the price is null or negative.

Internal processing: Read form.getPrice(); if the value is null or lower than the default price 0, throw the exception; otherwise return the value unchanged.

04

resolveStatus(action : ChapterSaveAction, price : int) : String

Purpose: Derive the publishing status of the new chapter from the save mode and the price.

Inputs: action: ChapterSaveAction — the requested save mode; price: int — the resolved price of the chapter.

Outputs: String — "DRAFT" when the action is not PUBLISHED, "PUBLISHED_VIP" when the action is PUBLISHED and the price is greater than 0, otherwise "PUBLISHED_REGULAR".

Internal processing: Return ChapterStatus.DRAFT when the action differs from PUBLISHED; when the action is PUBLISHED, compare the price with the default price 0 and return PUBLISHED_VIP for a paid chapter, PUBLISHED_REGULAR for a free chapter.

RichTextSanitizer Class

No

Method

Description

01

sanitize(html : String) : String

Purpose: Remove the tags and attributes that are not supported by the chapter editor before the content is persisted.

Inputs: html: String — the untrusted HTML produced by the rich text editor; a null value is treated as an empty string.

Outputs: String — the safe HTML fragment to store in the content column.

Internal processing: Parse the input with Jsoup.parseBodyFragment; run the Jsoup Cleaner against the allowed tag list (p, br, strong, b, em, i, u, s, h1–h3, ul, ol, li, blockquote, div, span, font); for each remaining element, filter the class attribute against the allowed CSS classes, remove the disallowed font face, size and colour values, keep only the font-size and line-height declarations of the style attribute, and remove an invalid align value of the div elements; finally return the cleaned body HTML trimmed.

d. Database Queries

SELECT id, title, slug, author, status FROM novels WHERE id = ? AND is_deleted = FALSE;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapters WHERE novel_id = ? AND chapter_number = ?;

INSERT INTO chapters (novel_id, chapter_number, title, content, price, status, is_deleted, views) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, FALSE, 0) RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, title, content, is_read, created_at) SELECT b.user_id, ?, ?, FALSE, NOW() FROM bookshelves b JOIN novels n ON n.id = b.novel_id JOIN chapters c ON c.id = ? AND c.novel_id = b.novel_id WHERE b.novel_id = ? AND n.is_deleted = false AND n.status != 'ARCHIVED' AND c.is_deleted = false AND c.status IN ('PUBLISHED_REGULAR', 'PUBLISHED_VIP') AND (? IS NULL OR b.user_id != ?) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notifications notif WHERE notif.user_id = b.user_id AND notif.title = ?);

The whole operation runs in one read-only transaction.

02

updateChapter(novelId : Integer, chapterId : Integer, form : ChapterForm, action : ChapterSaveAction) : Chapter

Purpose: Apply the changes of the Edit Chapter form to an existing chapter.

Inputs: novelId: Integer — the identifier of the parent novel; chapterId: Integer — the identifier of the chapter; form: ChapterForm — the validated form data; action: ChapterSaveAction — DRAFT or PUBLISHED.

Outputs: The persisted Chapter entity; ResourceNotFoundException ("Không tìm thấy truyện" or "Không tìm thấy chương") when the novel or the chapter does not exist, DuplicateResourceException ("Số chương đã tồn tại trong truyện này") when the chapter number is already used by another chapter and IllegalArgumentException ("Giá Coin phải lớn hơn hoặc bằng 0") when the price is negative.

Internal processing: Call findActiveNovel(novelId) and findActiveChapter(novelId, chapterId); remember the current status in oldStatus; call chapterRepository.existsByNovelIdAndChapterNumberAndIdNot(novelId, form.getChapterNumber(), chapterId) and throw the DuplicateResourceException when it returns true, so that the chapter keeps its own number; set the new chapter number, the trimmed title, the sanitized content, the resolved price and the resolved status on the entity; call chapterRepository.save(chapter) to persist the change; when the previous status was DRAFT and the new action is PUBLISHED, call notificationService.notifyNewChapterPublished(novelId, savedChapter.getId()) to inform the followers. The whole operation runs in one write transaction.

03

findActiveNovel(novelId : Integer) : Novel

Purpose: Find the parent novel by its identifier, ignoring the soft-deleted records.

Inputs: novelId: Integer — the identifier of the novel.

Outputs: The Novel entity; ResourceNotFoundException ("Không tìm thấy truyện") when the novel does not exist or has been deleted.

Internal processing: Call novelRepository.findByIdAndIsDeletedFalse(novelId) and throw the exception when the result is empty.

04

findActiveChapter(novelId : Integer, chapterId : Integer) : Chapter

Purpose: Find the chapter by its identifier inside the given novel, ignoring the soft-deleted records.

Inputs: novelId: Integer — the identifier of the parent novel; chapterId: Integer — the identifier of the chapter.

Outputs: The Chapter entity; ResourceNotFoundException ("Không tìm thấy chương") when the chapter does not exist, has been deleted or does not belong to the novel.

Internal processing: Call chapterRepository.findByIdAndNovelIdAndIsDeletedFalse(chapterId, novelId) and throw the exception when the result is empty.

05

resolvePrice(form : ChapterForm) : int

Purpose: Determine and validate the coin price of the updated chapter.

Inputs: form: ChapterForm — the submitted form data.

Outputs: int — the valid price; IllegalArgumentException ("Giá Coin phải lớn hơn hoặc bằng 0") when the price is null or negative.

Internal processing: Read form.getPrice(); if the value is null or lower than the default price 0, throw the exception; otherwise return the value unchanged.

06

resolveStatus(action : ChapterSaveAction, price : int) : String

Purpose: Derive the publishing status of the updated chapter from the save mode and the price.

Inputs: action: ChapterSaveAction — the requested save mode; price: int — the resolved price of the chapter.

Outputs: String — "DRAFT" when the action is not PUBLISHED, "PUBLISHED_VIP" when the action is PUBLISHED and the price is greater than 0, otherwise "PUBLISHED_REGULAR".

Internal processing: Return ChapterStatus.DRAFT when the action differs from PUBLISHED; when the action is PUBLISHED, compare the price with the default price 0 and return PUBLISHED_VIP for a paid chapter, PUBLISHED_REGULAR for a free chapter.

c. Sequence Diagram(s)

d. Database Queries

SELECT id, title, slug, author, status FROM novels WHERE id = ? AND is_deleted = FALSE;

SELECT id, novel_id, chapter_number, title, content, price, status, is_deleted, views FROM chapters WHERE id = ? AND novel_id = ? AND is_deleted = FALSE;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapters WHERE novel_id = ? AND chapter_number = ? AND id != ?;

UPDATE chapters SET chapter_number = ?, title = ?, content = ?, price = ?, status = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ? AND novel_id = ?;

INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, title, content, is_read, created_at) SELECT b.user_id, ?, ?, FALSE, NOW() FROM bookshelves b JOIN novels n ON n.id = b.novel_id JOIN chapters c ON c.id = ? AND c.novel_id = b.novel_id WHERE b.novel_id = ? AND n.is_deleted = false AND n.status != 'ARCHIVED' AND c.is_deleted = false AND c.status IN ('PUBLISHED_REGULAR', 'PUBLISHED_VIP') AND (? IS NULL OR b.user_id != ?) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notifications notif WHERE notif.user_id = b.user_id AND notif.title = ?);

01

DRAFT / PUBLISHED_REGULAR / PUBLISHED_VIP / LOCKED

Purpose: Enumerate the editorial, security and access states of a chapter.

ChapterAdminController Class

Method

Description

01

updateChapter(novelId : Integer, chapterId : Integer, form : ChapterForm, action : ChapterSaveAction) : String

Purpose: Handle the request that reconfigures a published chapter by changing its coin price and its publishing status.

Inputs: novelId: Integer — the identifier of the parent novel; chapterId: Integer — the identifier of the chapter; form: ChapterForm — the bound and validated form data carrying the chapter number, the title, the content and the new price; action: ChapterSaveAction — the requested save mode, DRAFT or PUBLISHED (default DRAFT).

Outputs: The redirect view "redirect:/admin/novels/{novelId}/chapters" with the flash message "Đã cập nhật và xuất bản chương thành công." when the chapter has been reconfigured; the view name "admin/chapters/configure" when the form has errors or when the price is invalid; the redirect view "redirect:/admin/novels/{novelId}/chapters" when the novel or the chapter does not exist.

Internal processing: If bindingResult.hasErrors() is true, re-render the configuration form with the current data; otherwise call chapterService.updateChapter(novelId, chapterId, form, action) and store the flash message of the success; when the coin price is negative, catch the IllegalArgumentException, reject the "price" field with the error message and re-render the configuration form; when the novel or the chapter is not found, catch the ResourceNotFoundException, store its message as "errorMessage" and redirect to the Chapter List.

updateChapter(novelId : Integer, chapterId : Integer, form : ChapterForm, action : ChapterSaveAction) : Chapter

ChapterServiceImpl Class

No

Method

Description

01

updateChapter(novelId : Integer, chapterId : Integer, form : ChapterForm, action : ChapterSaveAction) : Chapter

Purpose: Apply the new configuration of a chapter, that is its coin price and its publishing status.

Inputs: novelId: Integer — the identifier of the parent novel; chapterId: Integer — the identifier of the chapter; form: ChapterForm — the validated form data; action: ChapterSaveAction — DRAFT or PUBLISHED.

Outputs: The persisted Chapter entity; ResourceNotFoundException ("Không tìm thấy truyện" or "Không tìm thấy chương") when the novel or the chapter does not exist, DuplicateResourceException ("Số chương đã tồn tại trong truyện này") when the chapter number is already used by another chapter and IllegalArgumentException ("Giá Coin phải lớn hơn hoặc bằng 0") when the coin price is invalid.

Internal processing: Call findActiveNovel(novelId) and findActiveChapter(novelId, chapterId); remember the current status in oldStatus; call chapterRepository.existsByNovelIdAndChapterNumberAndIdNot(novelId, form.getChapterNumber(), chapterId) and throw the DuplicateResourceException when it returns true; resolve the new price with resolvePrice(form) and the new status with resolveStatus(action, price); set the new chapter number, the trimmed title, the sanitized content, the resolved price and the resolved status on the entity; call chapterRepository.save(chapter) to persist the change; when the previous status was DRAFT and the new action is PUBLISHED, call notificationService.notifyNewChapterPublished(novelId, savedChapter.getId()) to inform the followers. The whole operation runs in one write transaction.

02

findActiveNovel(novelId : Integer) : Novel

Purpose: Find the parent novel by its identifier, ignoring the soft-deleted records.

Inputs: novelId: Integer — the identifier of the novel.

Outputs: The Novel entity; ResourceNotFoundException ("Không tìm thấy truyện") when the novel does not exist or has been deleted.

Internal processing: Call novelRepository.findByIdAndIsDeletedFalse(novelId) and throw the exception when the result is empty.

03

findActiveChapter(novelId : Integer, chapterId : Integer) : Chapter

Purpose: Find the chapter by its identifier inside the given novel, ignoring the soft-deleted records.

Inputs: novelId: Integer — the identifier of the parent novel; chapterId: Integer — the identifier of the chapter.

Outputs: The Chapter entity with its current price and status; ResourceNotFoundException ("Không tìm thấy chương") when the chapter does not exist, has been deleted or does not belong to the novel.

Internal processing: Call chapterRepository.findByIdAndNovelIdAndIsDeletedFalse(chapterId, novelId) and throw the exception when the result is empty; the loaded price is the old price of the chapter and is recorded for the audit trail.

04

resolvePrice(form : ChapterForm) : int

Purpose: Determine and validate the new coin price of the reconfigured chapter.

Inputs: form: ChapterForm — the submitted form data holding the new price.

Outputs: int — the valid price; IllegalArgumentException ("Giá Coin phải lớn hơn hoặc bằng 0") when the price is null or negative.

Internal processing: Read form.getPrice(); if the value is null or lower than the default price 0, throw the exception; otherwise return the value unchanged, so that the price 0 keeps the chapter free and any positive value turns it into a paid VIP chapter.

05

resolveStatus(action : ChapterSaveAction, price : int) : String

Purpose: Derive the new publishing status of the reconfigured chapter from the save mode and the new price.

Inputs: action: ChapterSaveAction — the requested save mode; price: int — the resolved price of the chapter.

Outputs: String — "DRAFT" when the action is not PUBLISHED, "PUBLISHED_VIP" when the action is PUBLISHED and the price is greater than 0, otherwise "PUBLISHED_REGULAR".

Internal processing: Return ChapterStatus.DRAFT when the action differs from PUBLISHED; when the action is PUBLISHED, compare the price with the default price 0 and return PUBLISHED_VIP for a paid chapter, PUBLISHED_REGULAR for a free chapter; the LOCKED status is preserved only when the chapter is locked by the staff and is never produced by this resolution.

RichTextSanitizer Class

No

Method

Description

01

sanitize(html : String) : String

Purpose: Remove the tags and attributes that are not supported by the chapter editor before the content is persisted.

Inputs: html: String — the untrusted HTML produced by the rich text editor; a null value is treated as an empty string.

Outputs: String — the safe HTML fragment to store in the content column.

Internal processing: Parse the input with Jsoup.parseBodyFragment; run the Jsoup Cleaner against the allowed tag list (p, br, strong, b, em, i, u, s, h1–h3, ul, ol, li, blockquote, div, span, font); for each remaining element, filter the class attribute against the allowed CSS classes, remove the disallowed font face, size and colour values, keep only the font-size and line-height declarations of the style attribute, and remove an invalid align value of the div elements; finally return the cleaned body HTML trimmed.

ChapterStatus Class

No

Method

Description

01

DRAFT / PUBLISHED_REGULAR / PUBLISHED_VIP / LOCKED

Purpose: Enumerate the editorial, security and access states of a chapter.

Inputs: none — the constants are declared by the enumeration.

Outputs: DRAFT ("Bản nháp") — the chapter is private and not visible to the readers; PUBLISHED_REGULAR ("Xuất bản thường") — the chapter is public and free; PUBLISHED_VIP ("Xuất bản VIP") — the chapter is public but requires a paid unlock; LOCKED ("Đã khóa") — the chapter is hidden from the readers by the staff.

Internal processing: The enumeration is stored as the name of the status column of the table chapters; when a chapter is reconfigured the status is recomputed from the new price, so the value PUBLISHED_VIP means that the access policy requires a paid unlock, while the value LOCKED is only set by the explicit lock operation.

d. Database Queries

SELECT DISTINCT n.id, n.title, n.slug, n.author, n.summary, n.cover_url, n.status, n.views, n.average_rating, n.chapter_count, n.created_at, n.updated_at FROM novels n WHERE n.is_deleted = false AND (LOWER(n.title) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', ?, '%')) OR LOWER(n.author) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', ?, '%'))) AND n.status <> 'ARCHIVED' ORDER BY n.updated_at DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT n.id) FROM novels n WHERE n.is_deleted = false AND (LOWER(n.title) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', ?, '%')) OR LOWER(n.author) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', ?, '%'))) AND n.status <> 'ARCHIVED';

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.description, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM novel_categories nc JOIN novels n ON nc.novel_id = n.id WHERE nc.category_id = c.id AND n.is_deleted = false) AS novelCount FROM categories c ORDER BY c.id ASC;
