7.4 View Novel Details

a. Class Diagram

 

b. Class Specifications

NovelController Class

No

Method

Description

01

novelDetailsBySlug

- Input: slug: String, authentication: Authentication, model: Model.

- Output: String (View name "novel/details").

- Internal Method Processing: Handles GET /truyen/{slug} request. Retrieves the public novel by slug via novelService.getPublicNovelBySlug(slug) and fetches its published table of contents via chapterService.getPublicChapters(novelId). If the user is authenticated, checks bookshelf membership (isNovelInBookshelf), reading history existence (hasReadAnyChapter), and latest read chapter bookmark (getLastReadChapter). Also fetches total favorites (countNovelFavorites) and related works by the same author (getNovelsBySameAuthor), binds all attributes to the Model, and renders "novel/details".

NovelService Interface

No

Method

Description

01

getPublicNovelBySlug

- Input: slug: String.

- Output: Novel.

- Internal Method Processing: Retrieves an active, non-archived novel matching the given URL slug or throws ResourceNotFoundException if not found.

02

getNovelsBySameAuthor

- Input: author: String, currentNovelId: Integer.

- Output: List<Novel>.

- Internal Method Processing: Retrieves up to 5 public novels written by the same author (excluding the current novel) ordered by views descending.

NovelServiceImpl Class

No

Method

Description

01

getPublicNovelBySlug

- Input: slug: String.

- Output: Novel.

- Internal Method Processing: Validates that slug is non-blank and queries novelRepository.findBySlugAndIsDeletedFalseAndStatusNot(slug, "ARCHIVED"). Throws ResourceNotFoundException if the novel does not exist, is soft-deleted, or is archived.

02

getNovelsBySameAuthor

- Input: author: String, currentNovelId: Integer.

- Output: List<Novel>.

- Internal Method Processing: Queries novelRepository.findTop5ByAuthorIgnoreCaseAndIdNotAndIsDeletedFalseOrderByViewsDesc() and filters out archived novels to display related titles by the same author.

ChapterService Interface

No

Method

Description

01

getPublicChapters

- Input: novelId: Integer.

- Output: List<Chapter>.

- Internal Method Processing: Retrieves all publicly published chapters belonging to the specified novel ordered by chapter number ascending.

ChapterServiceImpl Class

No

Method

Description

01

getPublicChapters

- Input: novelId: Integer.

- Output: List<Chapter>.

c. Sequence Diagram(s)

d. Database Queries

1. Retrieve public novel by slug

SELECT id, title, slug, author, summary, cover_url, status, is_deleted, uploader_id, views, average_rating, rating_count, created_at, updated_at FROM novels WHERE slug = ? AND is_deleted = FALSE AND status <> 'ARCHIVED';

2. Verify public novel by ID

SELECT id, title, slug, author, summary, cover_url, status, is_deleted, uploader_id, views, average_rating, rating_count, created_at, updated_at FROM novels WHERE id = ? AND is_deleted = FALSE AND status <> 'ARCHIVED';

3. Retrieve all published chapters of the novel

SELECT id, novel_id, chapter_number, title, price, status, views, created_at, updated_at FROM chapters WHERE novel_id = ? AND is_deleted = FALSE AND status IN ('PUBLISHED_REGULAR', 'PUBLISHED_VIP', 'PUBLISHED') ORDER BY chapter_number ASC;

4. Retrieve authenticated user by email

SELECT id, email, password, full_name, avatar_url, wallet_balance, auth_provider, status, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE email = ?;

5. Check if novel is in user's bookshelf

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bookshelves WHERE user_id = ? AND novel_id = ?);

6. Count read chapters of the novel for the user

SELECT COUNT(uca.id) FROM user_chapter_activities uca INNER JOIN chapters c ON uca.chapter_id = c.id WHERE uca.user_id = ? AND c.novel_id = ? AND uca.is_read = TRUE;

7. Retrieve latest read chapter activity for "Continue Reading"

SELECT uca.id, uca.user_id, uca.chapter_id, uca.is_read, uca.read_at, c.chapter_number, c.title, c.status FROM user_chapter_activities uca INNER JOIN chapters c ON uca.chapter_id = c.id WHERE uca.user_id = ? AND c.novel_id = ? AND uca.is_read = TRUE ORDER BY uca.read_at DESC, c.chapter_number DESC LIMIT 1;

8. Count total bookshelf favorites for the novel

SELECT COUNT(id) FROM bookshelves WHERE novel_id = ?;

9. Retrieve top 5 novels by the same author

SELECT id, title, slug, author, summary, cover_url, status, views, average_rating, rating_count FROM novels WHERE LOWER(author) = LOWER(?) AND id <> ? AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 5;

home

- Input: authentication: Authentication, model: Model.

Invokes homeService.getHomePageData() to retrieve categorized novel lists (recently updated, hot/most-viewed, completed, recommended, and newly created novels). Method

01

getHomePageData

- Input: None.

- Output: HomePageDTO.

- Internal Method Processing: Queries NovelRepository for five homepage sections: top 12 recently updated novels, top 10 hot novels by view count, top 12 completed novels, top 12 recommended novels (having at least one published chapter, ordered by average rating and views), and top 12 newly added novels. Filters out archived novels using publicNovels(), transforms each Novel entity into a NovelSummaryDTO via mapToSummaryDTO(), and builds the aggregated HomePageDTO object.

02

mapToSummaryDTO

- Input: novel: Novel, includeChapters: boolean.

- Output: NovelSummaryDTO.

- Internal Method Processing: Queries bookshelfRepository.countByNovelId() to get the total favorite count for the novel. If includeChapters is true, queries chapterRepository.findTop3ByNovelIdAndIsDeletedFalseAndStatusInOrderByChapterNumberDesc() to fetch up to 3 latest published chapters and maps them to LatestChapterDTO with formatted relative timestamps. Constructs and returns a NovelSummaryDTO.

publicNovels

c. Sequence Diagram(s)

d. Database Queries

1. Retrieve all active novel categories

SELECT id, name, slug, description FROM categories ORDER BY name ASC;

2. Retrieve top 12 recently updated novels

SELECT id, title, slug, author, summary, cover_url, status, is_deleted, uploader_id, views, average_rating, rating_count, created_at, updated_at FROM novels WHERE is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 12;

3. Retrieve top 10 hot novels by view count

SELECT id, title, slug, author, summary, cover_url, status, is_deleted, uploader_id, views, average_rating, rating_count, created_at, updated_at FROM novels WHERE is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 10;

4. Retrieve top 12 completed novels

SELECT id, title, slug, author, summary, cover_url, status, is_deleted, uploader_id, views, average_rating, rating_count, created_at, updated_at FROM novels WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND status = ? ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 12;

5. Retrieve top 12 recommended public novels

SELECT n.id, n.title, n.slug, n.author, n.summary, n.cover_url, n.status, n.is_deleted, n.uploader_id, n.views, n.average_rating, n.rating_count, n.created_at, n.updated_at FROM novels n WHERE n.is_deleted = FALSE AND n.status <> 'ARCHIVED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chapters c WHERE c.novel_id = n.id AND c.is_deleted = FALSE AND c.status IN ('PUBLISHED_REGULAR', 'PUBLISHED_VIP', 'PUBLISHED')) ORDER BY n.average_rating DESC, n.views DESC LIMIT 12 OFFSET 0;

6. Retrieve top 12 newly created novels

SELECT id, title, slug, author, summary, cover_url, status, is_deleted, uploader_id, views, average_rating, rating_count, created_at, updated_at FROM novels WHERE is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 12;

7. Check if hero featured novel is in authenticated user's bookshelf

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bookshelves WHERE user_id = ? AND novel_id = ?);

8. Count total bookshelf favorites for a novel

SELECT COUNT(id) FROM bookshelves WHERE novel_id = ?;

9. Retrieve top 3 latest published chapters per novel

SELECT id, novel_id, chapter_number, title, price, status, views, created_at, updated_at FROM chapters WHERE novel_id = ? AND is_deleted = FALSE AND status IN ('PUBLISHED_REGULAR', 'PUBLISHED_VIP', 'PUBLISHED') ORDER BY chapter_number DESC LIMIT 3;

c. Sequence Diagram(s)

d. Database Queries

1. Retrieve authenticated user by email

SELECT id, email, full_name, avatar_url, wallet_balance, status, created_at FROM users WHERE email = ?;

2. Retrieve all bookshelf entries with active novels for the user

SELECT b.id, b.user_id, b.novel_id, b.added_at, n.id AS novel_id, n.title, n.slug, n.author, n.cover_url, n.status, n.is_deleted FROM bookshelves b INNER JOIN novels n ON b.novel_id = n.id WHERE b.user_id = ? AND n.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY b.added_at DESC;

3. Count total non-deleted chapters of a novel

SELECT COUNT(id) FROM chapters WHERE novel_id = ? AND is_deleted = FALSE;

4. Check if novel has paid VIP chapters

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chapters WHERE novel_id = ? AND price > 0 AND is_deleted = FALSE);

5. Retrieve latest read chapter activity for a novel

SELECT uca.id, uca.user_id, uca.chapter_id, uca.is_read, uca.read_at, c.chapter_number, c.title FROM user_chapter_activities uca INNER JOIN chapters c ON uca.chapter_id = c.id WHERE uca.user_id = ? AND c.novel_id = ? AND uca.is_read = TRUE ORDER BY uca.read_at DESC, c.chapter_number DESC LIMIT 1;

6. Count chapters read by user for a novel

SELECT COUNT(uca.id) FROM user_chapter_activities uca INNER JOIN chapters c ON uca.chapter_id = c.id WHERE uca.user_id = ? AND c.novel_id = ? AND uca.is_read = TRUE;

DELETE FROM user_chapter_activities WHERE id = ?;

d. Database Queries

1. Retrieve public novel by slug

SELECT id, title, slug, author, summary, cover_url, status, is_deleted, views, average_rating, rating_count FROM novels WHERE slug = ? AND is_deleted = FALSE AND status <> 'ARCHIVED';

2. Retrieve published chapter by novel ID and chapter number

SELECT id, novel_id, chapter_number, title, content, price, auto_unlock_at, views, status, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM chapters WHERE novel_id = ? AND chapter_number = ? AND is_deleted = FALSE AND status IN ('PUBLISHED_REGULAR', 'PUBLISHED_VIP', 'PUBLISHED');

3. Increment chapter view count

UPDATE chapters SET views = views + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?;

4. Increment novel cumulative view count

UPDATE novels SET views = views + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?;

5. Retrieve authenticated user by email

SELECT id, email, full_name, wallet_balance, status FROM users WHERE email = ?;

6. Check user's unlock and reading activity for the chapter

SELECT id, user_id, chapter_id, is_read, read_at, is_unlocked, price_paid, unlocked_at FROM user_chapter_activities WHERE user_id = ? AND chapter_id = ?;

7. Retrieve all published chapters for previous/next chapter navigation

SELECT id, novel_id, chapter_number, title, price, status FROM chapters WHERE novel_id = ? AND is_deleted = FALSE AND status IN ('PUBLISHED_REGULAR', 'PUBLISHED_VIP', 'PUBLISHED') ORDER BY chapter_number ASC;

DailyCheckinServiceImpl Class

No

Method

Description

01

getCheckinStatus

- Input: email: String.

- Output: DailyCheckinStatusDTO.

- Internal Method Processing: Resolves the User by email, checks if a record exists for today via checkinRepository.findByUserAndCheckinDate(user, today), and inspects the most recent check-in via checkinRepository.findTopByUserOrderByCheckinDateDesc(user). Determines the active 1..7 cycle day (resetting to Day 1 if the streak was broken or completed Day 7), counts total check-in days via checkinRepository.countByUser(user), sums accumulated reward coins via checkinRepository.sumRewardCoinByUser(user), constructs the 7-day roadmap via buildRoadmap(), and returns DailyCheckinStatusDTO.

02

performCheckin

- Input: email: String.

- Output: DailyCheckinResultDTO.

- Internal Method Processing: Resolves the User by email and checks checkinRepository.existsByUserAndCheckinDate(user, today); if already checked in today, returns an unsuccessful DailyCheckinResultDTO. Otherwise, inspects yesterday's check-in via checkinRepository.findByUserAndCheckinDate(user, yesterday) to compute newStreak (1 to 7), determines rewardCoin (15 Coins on Day 7, 5 Coins on Days 1-6), saves the new UserDailyCheckin record, credits the user's wallet via walletService.addCoins(user, rewardCoin, "GIFT_COIN", checkinId, description), and returns the updated DailyCheckinResultDTO.

03

buildRoadmap

- Input: currentCycleDay: int, isCheckedInToday: boolean.

- Output: List<DayRoadmapItemDTO>.

- Internal Method Processing: Generates the 7-day check-in roadmap items (Days 1-6 with 5 Coins, Day 7 with 15 Coins) and assigns each day's status (CLAIMED, TODAY, or UPCOMING).

c. Sequence Diagram(s)

d. Database Queries

1. Retrieve authenticated user by email

SELECT id, email, full_name, wallet_balance, status FROM users WHERE email = ?;

2. Find user check-in record for a specific date

SELECT id, user_id, checkin_date, reward_coin, streak_count, created_at FROM user_daily_checkins WHERE user_id = ? AND checkin_date = ?;

3. Retrieve most recent check-in record for streak calculation

SELECT id, user_id, checkin_date, reward_coin, streak_count, created_at FROM user_daily_checkins WHERE user_id = ? ORDER BY checkin_date DESC LIMIT 1;

4. Count total check-in days for user

SELECT COUNT(id) FROM user_daily_checkins WHERE user_id = ?;

5. Calculate total accumulated check-in reward coins for user

SELECT SUM(reward_coin) FROM user_daily_checkins WHERE user_id = ?; 

6. Check if user has already checked in today

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_daily_checkins WHERE user_id = ? AND checkin_date = CURRENT_DATE);

7. Insert new daily check-in record

INSERT INTO user_daily_checkins (user_id, checkin_date, reward_coin, streak_count, created_at) VALUES (?, CURRENT_DATE, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) RETURNING id;

8. Update user wallet balance with reward Coins

UPDATE users SET wallet_balance = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?;

9. Insert GIFT_COIN reward transaction into wallet ledger

INSERT INTO transactions (user_id, amount, balance_after, type, reference_id, description, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'GIFT_COIN', ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) RETURNING id;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system_audit_logs WHERE created_at >= ?;
